body.value: The verb is singular, although the word for God that follows it is plural in form.
Two extremes are named to mean everything that lies between them: all that exists.
The two Hebrew words rhyme (tohu wa-bohu). Few translations keep the sound.
Beginning; the first or best part of something. This note applies wherever the lexeme occurs.
